results.title: Alexandria digital maps project — Egyptian Survey Authority

assessment: The search found the Egyptian Survey Authority's official Alexandria digital-maps project and a governorate district map. The cited project describes GIS maps at 1:1,000 and 1:5,000 scales, but this search did not establish an open parcel dataset or service endpoint.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
